description: Clone every repository a GitHub organization has into one folder.

options.description: GitHub token used to list and clone private repositories, and to lift the hourly request limit. Without it GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN and a signed-in `gh` are tried in that order.
Folder the clones land in when --out is not given. Without it they land in the directory the function is run in.
How repositories are cloned: `https`, which uses the token, or `ssh`, which uses the key already on the machine.
How many clones run at once.
